0.text: But alas that is the glory

1.text: for you shall always live amongst us as bits
and bytes in my little magic information rectangle

2.text:
The people of Earth,
coming together to
achieve the high score,
is truly a beautiful thing.

This beauty is something
that both you as well as I,
both possess!

3.text:
Now, citizens of the
earth!
You fine people who
challenge the high score.

My high score
is also your high score.

Let us talk to
our heart's content!

4.text:
This high score belongs
to me,
and it also belongs to you!
